description: An interaction or functional association between two distinct proteins, supported by experimental, structural, or predicted evidence depending on the source. Treat the relationship as undirected; IntAct can additionally annotate a direction of action through its evidence properties. A protein pair supported by multiple sources carries their provenance and evidence together.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: The interaction sources that assert this edge (the same names shown in this record's Sources). A pair supported by several sources lists all of them.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: When this edge was last created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: Human–human protein pairs; both proteins must already exist in SPOKE and both must be human (NCBITaxon:9606).
source_contributions.description: Physical human protein interactions from the BioPlex network, distributed through TCRD/Pharos and detected by affinity-purification mass spectrometry across engineered human cell lines. Three mutually exclusive outcome probabilities sum to approximately 1. All three values come from the record with greatest p_interaction, breaking ties by least p_wrong.

properties.name: p_interaction
properties.description: Probability that the interaction is real.

properties.name: p_no_interaction
properties.description: Probability that there is no interaction.

properties.name: p_wrong
properties.description: Probability that the protein pairing is a technical misassignment.

source_contributions.scope: Physical interactions with exactly one human partner and one non-human partner whose declared organism is represented in SPOKE; both proteins must be present. Human–human and non-human/non-human pairs, genetic interactions, and ambiguous protein assignments are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Curated physical protein–protein interactions from BioGRID; genetic interactions are excluded. Evidence from all supporting records for a pair is aggregated into unordered sets, so the link between a specific detection method and a specific publication is not preserved.

properties.name: biogrid_experimental_systems
properties.description: Experimental systems (assay types) in which the interaction was detected.
properties.notes: Distinct set aggregated over all supporting records for the pair.

properties.name: biogrid_throughput
properties.description: Throughput category (e.g. low- or high-throughput) of the detecting assays.
properties.notes: Distinct set aggregated over all supporting records for the pair.

properties.name: biogrid_pubmed_ids
properties.description: PubMed IDs of publications reporting the interaction.
properties.notes: Distinct set aggregated over all supporting records for the pair.

properties.name: biogrid_interaction_ids
properties.description: BioGRID interaction identifiers for the supporting records.
properties.notes: Distinct set aggregated over all supporting records for the pair.

source_contributions.scope: All organism pairings; both endpoints must resolve to existing, non-obsolete SPOKE Proteins. Self-interactions are skipped.
source_contributions.description: Molecular interactions from IntAct, which aggregates records from IMEx-consortium partners (including MINT, DIP, and UniProt). Coverage spans experimentally-determined association, binding, proximity, and enzymatic/covalent-reaction interaction types; spatial colocalization and purely computational predictions are excluded. Per-evidence details are stored as several equal-length, index-aligned arrays (position i refers to the same piece of evidence across every array); fields that are multi-valued per evidence, or per-interactor, are stored as distinct sets instead. Where the evidence cleanly implies an acting protein, directedness is recorded as edge properties — never as the stored edge orientation. Negative interaction records are excluded. Missing string-array values are represented by "unspecified" and missing scores by NaN. Directedness requires at least one direction-bearing evidence record and agreement on the acting protein across all such records; conflicting directions leave the directedness properties absent.

properties.name: intact_interaction_ids
properties.type: list of strings (**per-evidence array, group A**)
properties.description: Primary IntAct interaction identifier for each piece of evidence.

properties.name: intact_miscores
properties.type: list of floats (**per-evidence array, group A**)
properties.description: IntAct MI-score (confidence, 0–1) for each piece of evidence.

properties.name: intact_detection_methods
properties.type: list of strings (**per-evidence array, group A**)
properties.description: Interaction detection method (human-readable) for each piece of evidence.

properties.name: intact_interaction_types
properties.type: list of strings (**per-evidence array, group A**)
properties.description: Interaction type (human-readable) for each piece of evidence.

properties.name: intact_source_databases
properties.type: list of strings (**per-evidence array, group A**)
properties.description: Originating source database (human-readable) for each piece of evidence.

properties.name: intact_pubmed_ids
properties.type: list of strings (**distinct set, group B**)
properties.description: PubMed IDs supporting the interaction.

properties.name: intact_biological_roles
properties.type: list of strings (**distinct set, group B**)
properties.description: Biological roles observed for the interactors (excluding 'unspecified role').

properties.name: intact_isoform_chain_accessions
properties.type: list of strings (**distinct set, group B**)
properties.description: Isoform- or chain-specific UniProt forms observed for the pair (collapsed to base accession for matching).

properties.name: intact_is_directed
properties.description: True when the evidence cleanly indicates a direction of action. Absent means undirected/unknown (never stored as false).

properties.name: intact_directed_actor
properties.description: UniProtKB identifier of the acting protein, when the interaction is directed.

properties.name: intact_direction_roles
properties.description: Observed 'actor role -> target role' descriptions behind the direction.
properties.notes: Distinct set; present only when directed.

source_contributions.scope: Human–human functional associations with combined score ≥400; both proteins must be present and non-obsolete. Ambiguous assignments and self-pairs are excluded.
source_contributions.description: STRING integrates experimental and biochemical evidence, curated pathway and complex databases, literature text mining, co-expression, genomic neighborhood, gene fusion, and phylogenetic co-occurrence. Functional association does not necessarily mean direct physical contact. All eight scores come from one selected record: greatest combined score, then greatest experimental score. Scores retain the raw 0–1000 scale.

properties.name: string_combined_score
properties.description: STRING combined confidence score; higher values indicate greater confidence. On human STRING associations it is ≥400 on the 0–1000 scale; on STRING Viruses associations it is 150–999 and is the maximum over supporting rows.
properties.notes: Shared by STRING and STRING Viruses on disjoint human–human and human–virus pairs.

properties.name: string_neighborhood_score
properties.description: Genomic neighborhood evidence score.

properties.name: string_fusion_score
properties.description: Gene fusion evidence score.

properties.name: string_cooccurrence_score
properties.description: Phylogenetic co-occurrence evidence score.

properties.name: string_coexpression_score
properties.description: Co-expression evidence score.

properties.name: string_experimental_score
properties.description: Experimental and biochemical evidence score.

properties.name: string_database_score
properties.description: Curated pathway and complex database evidence score.

properties.name: string_textmining_score
properties.description: Literature text-mining evidence score.

source_contributions.scope: Human ↔ viral protein pairs (exactly one human and one viral partner), both present in SPOKE.
source_contributions.description: Predicted virus–host protein associations from Viruses.STRING. The shared string_combined_score property described under STRING holds the maximum score over supporting rows for these pairs (150–999, higher means greater confidence). No additional confidence cutoff is applied. Standard confidence bands are ≥400 (medium), ≥700 (high), and ≥900 (highest).

source_contributions.scope: Human ↔ non-human protein pairs; both endpoints must resolve to existing, non-obsolete SPOKE Proteins.
source_contributions.description: Experimentally-observed virus–host protein interactions from VirHostNet; computational predictions are excluded. Per-record evidence is stored as equal-length, index-aligned arrays (position i refers to the same VirHostNet record across every array), plus a distinct set of any isoform/chain-specific UniProt forms seen. Colocalization evidence is retained, so this contribution does not always imply direct physical contact. Missing string-array values use "unspecified" and missing scores use NaN.

properties.name: virhost_interaction_ids
properties.description: VirHostNet record identifier for each supporting record.

properties.name: virhost_miscores
properties.description: VirHostNet MI-score (confidence) for each supporting record.

properties.name: virhost_detection_methods
properties.description: Interaction detection method (human-readable) for each supporting record.

properties.name: virhost_pubmed_ids
properties.description: PubMed ID for each supporting record.

properties.name: virhost_isoform_chain_accessions
properties.description: Isoform- or chain-specific UniProt forms observed for the pair (collapsed to base accession for matching).
properties.notes: Distinct set; present only when such forms were observed.

source_contributions.scope: Distinct proteins observed in contact through Pfam domain interfaces in PDB crystal structures. Interfaces must involve different asymmetric-unit chains and appear in at least one PISA-validated biological assembly (NumPisaBAs > 0). Both proteins must be present and non-obsolete; protein self-interactions are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Structural evidence for protein interactions derived from ProtCID domain–domain interface summaries. No symmetry-operator constraint is applied.

properties.name: domainInteraction
properties.description: True when the protein interaction is evidenced by a structurally observed domain–domain interface.
properties.notes: **Absent** = not a known domain-level interaction; **never stored as `false`**
